verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS work-management product like Jira, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out control. The listed features (SAML/SSO, configuration, integrations) are about other capabilities and are not privacy opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
